profile_identity.name: Tianshu Qu
profile_identity.discovery: https://www.alphaxiv.org/@tianshu-qu links to the exact Google Scholar profile; identity then verified on Google Scholar itself.

acquisition.method: Ordinary HTTPS GET via Python urllib.request using a standard Mozilla/5.0 user agent. No captcha, proxy rotation, credentials, login, or access-limit bypass used.
acquisition.webToolResult: web.run returned 403 on bare profile URL; ordinary HTTPS returned 200 for four normal profile pages and one citation detail page.
acquisition.pagination: pagesize=100, cstart=0 and cstart=100 in default citation order and sortby=pubdate date order; each last page has 2 entries and Show more disabled.

interpretation: Ranks are one-based positions in the actual Google Scholar profile ordering, including non-paper entries; the gaps are intentional.

The citation count is an integer only when a number was displayed by Google Scholar. A blank citation cell is represented as null, with citedByText retained as an empty string; it is not silently changed to zero.
Match IDs are unique: no Google Scholar record or citation count is assigned to two separate site scholarly records.
Some scholarly records are absent from the profile. Keep those site records; citation and Scholar rank stay null.

Site publication metadata was not changed. Scholar year differs from site year for Individualized HRTF-based Binaural Renderer for Higher-Order Ambisonics (2020 vs 2021); Scholar ordering uses the observed Scholar year/rank.
